recommendations.recommendation: Treat filial piety as the root of all virtue and the basis of teaching.
recommendations.rationale: Filial piety is the foundation from which virtue and moral instruction grow.
rationale_type: authority of a person or tradition

recommendations.recommendation: Take care of your body, since it was received from your parents.
recommendations.rationale: Not harming the body is where filial piety begins.
rationale_type: authority of a person or tradition

recommendations.recommendation: Serve parents with love and respect, and support them in old age.
recommendations.rationale: Love and reverence are the substance of filial duty.
rationale_type: authority of a person or tradition

recommendations.recommendation: Establish yourself and win fame so as to honor your parents.
recommendations.rationale: Bringing honor to parents is the end of filial piety.
rationale_type: authority of a person or tradition

recommendations.recommendation: Rulers should lead by love and respect, avoiding arrogance, so the people follow.
recommendations.rationale: Rulers' example shapes the people and secures the state.
rationale_type: authority of a person or tradition

recommendations.recommendation: Serve the ruler with the same loyalty you give your father.
recommendations.rationale: Filial piety extends to loyalty in office.
rationale_type: authority of a person or tradition

recommendations.recommendation: Commoners should work the land with the seasons and be thrifty to support parents.
rationale_type: authority of a person or tradition

recommendations.recommendation: Remonstrate with a parent or ruler who is acting wrongly.
recommendations.rationale: Obedience without protest to wrong conduct is not true filiality.
rationale_type: authority of a person or tradition

recommendations.recommendation: Mourn dead parents and make sacrifices to them in season.
rationale_type: authority of a person or tradition
